cross_product_finding: This page is the clearest example in the batch of a genuine Capella-only distinction that the server/-derived vocabulary doesn't cover: availability of sequential scan is gated by Capella billing/service-plan tier ('Query without Indexes is not available by default for paid service plans'; free-tier clusters get it by default, paid plans require contacting support to enable it). This has no equivalent on server/, which has no billing plans - server/'s gating vocabulary is edition-based (EE/CE), Capella's is billing-plan-based. Minted a new gatedByBillingPlan predicate rather than forcing this into requiresEdition/behavesDifferentlyUnder.
